descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S15 「生产 team 的 Convex 套餐档位是符合 BAA 条件的档位」 Convex plan tier of the production team is the BAA-eligible tier

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 The Convex plan tier is the BAA-eligible tier: the actual account plan supports the BAA, not just that a BAA document exists. …（UAT OAT-05；TFA-92568 AC 9；TFA-92568 Product 2；TFA-94703 B1；TFA-94703 AC 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress; TFA-94703 development backlog

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Someone with admin access to the Convex team that owns the production deployment (Venkata Technologies per TFA-94703; Topflight should have admin access)

When Capture the team's billing/plan page, dated, and the Convex BAA. Note which plan the BAA requires and which team signed it.

Then The plan on the team is the tier the Convex BAA names as eligible (TFA-94703 says Pro). The BAA was signed for this same team. Topflight is an admin on it.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-05 step 4 'not just that a BAA document exists, but that the actual account plan supports it', TFA-92568 AC 9 and TFA-94703 B1. A lower tier, a trial, or a BAA on a different team is a Fail. The dev team is judged per Q12.

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 CONFIG · 配置核对；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S15 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-05.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：CONFIG · 配置核对；辅助：DOC · 文档核对 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 dev 跑；来源：dev。
